title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Fold
subtitle: 节日庆典 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 节日庆典（人与社会·历史社会与文化）
meta: 主题语境：节日庆典（人与社会·历史社会与文化）　|　核心词汇：dumpling　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dumpling 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my grandmother ① made a dumpling that no guest in the house would have eaten, and she said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② dumpling, meaning the parcel and not the dough, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a dumpling, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left uneaten.

Every ③ dumpling in that house had the same short fold at the edge of it, and the ④ dumpling at the end, meaning the one they kept for the new year and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A dumpling, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to eat; my grandmother said the eating is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the dumpling was the whole of the story, meaning the dough and not the parcel. The ⑥ dumpling, meaning the dough and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody shapes and nobody names; dumpling, she said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a parcel and a dough. She said the dough is the part they remember.

By 1956 the ⑦ dumpling had become a line in a menu, and the menu had become an argument about the short fold. The ⑧ dumpling of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and fourteen winters of eating; dumpling, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to eat. She said the eating was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dumpling I remember is the one named in the menu, which was dropped in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ dumpling, my mother said in 1970, is the only one that improves by being eaten; every dumpling, she said, is a dough that has agreed to look like a parcel. She said the dough was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 饺子；汤团（指那座房子里包过的那一只）
B. n. 饺子；汤团（指那只饺子本身，与面团相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a dumpling 包一只饺子
D. n. 饺子；汤团（指留给新年的那一只）
E. n. 饺子；汤团（抽象总称，指一家人的包饺子之事）
F. n. 饺子；汤团（指菜单上写到、被列名的那一种）
G. n. 面团；团子状的东西（指故事里人人都捏却无人命名的那样东西）
H. n. 面团（抽象总称，指人人都捏却无人命名的那种东西）

items.q: made a dumpling that no guest in the house would have eaten
The dumpling, meaning the parcel and not the dough
the dumpling was the whole of the story
the dumpling had become a line in a menu
The dumpling of the whole thing

answers.why: make a dumpling 意为“包一只饺子”，1947 年祖母包了一只屋子里没有一位客人肯吃的饺子。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，指那只饺子本身而不是面团，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，指那座房子里的每一只饺子，每一只边上都有一道短短的褶。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，指留给新年的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
dumpling 意为“面团、团子状的东西”，指故事里人人都捏却无人命名的那样东西，姑姑说这团面就是那个故事的全部。
dumpling 意为“面团”，指人人都捏却无人命名的那种东西而不是那只饺子，是故事里人人都捏、却无人命名的东西。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，指菜单上写到、被列名的那一种，到 1956 年这只饺子成了菜单里的一行。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，祖母一月写道，整件事的包饺子之事是一座房子和十四个冬天的吃食。
dumpling 意为“饺子、汤团”，我记得的是菜单上列名的那一种，1968 年不再做了，至今仍被说成屋子里最安静的一种。
dumpling 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，一只饺子是唯一会因为被好好吃掉而变得更好的东西。
